chapters.label: The winning kick
chapters.text: Basel, the 2025 Euro final. Penalties! Score this one, and England are champions. Chloe Kelly spins the ball. She breathes. Here's the run... smashed high into the net! England win!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. She picked her spot before the run. Head still, and she hits it hard. No doubt!

chapters.label: To the fans
chapters.text: From behind the goal: too high for the keeper! Kelly races to the England fans, and her teammates pile on.

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Under pressure, pick your spot early. Stick to your routine, then strike with conviction.
